title: MS Engineer OSS
description:
**Job Description**
We are seeking a highly skilled OSS Expert with strong experience in GDC NOC Operations, Linux administration, OpenShift, and Kubernetes environments. The ideal candidate should have hands-on expertise in Nokia Cloud Platform (NCP), Nokia Cloud Operations Manager (NCOM), and NetAct/NSP/OSS products, including Fault, Configuration, and Problem Management within Enterprise Networks (Private Wireless LTE). Strong knowledge of Git & GitHub, CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and production support is essential. The role also requires experience working across multi-domain network elements, ensuring system stability, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enable efficient cloud operations and seamless service delivery.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Resolution & providing technical support for the incidents reported/request Cloud products, including Nokia Cloud Platform (NCP), Nokia Cloud Operations Manager (NCOM), OSS Products (Analysis, Troubleshooting & fixing the issues reported).
* Manages technical escalations for technical requests, emergency cases and outages internally and towards customers.
* Strong hands-on experience with Linux administration, including user management, file system management, process monitoring, and system troubleshooting.
* Good knowledge of Linux shell scripting, package management, service configuration, and performance monitoring in production environments.
* Strong experience in Git & GitHub for source code management, branching strategies, and collaborative development workflows.
* Hands-on expertise in Kubernetes for container orchestration, application deployments, scaling, and monitoring.
* Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines, deployment automation, and release management processes.
* Experience in managing and deploying applications on OpenShift platforms.
* Proficient in troubleshooting deployment issues and maintaining high availability environments.
* Ability to work closely with development and infrastructure teams for seamless delivery and operations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders like GDC, Care, Field, 3 rd PP & Customer to resolve the issues.
* Participate in CAB/CR meetings. Preparing & Validating the MoPs and executing the CRs with 100% FTR.
* Design, deploy, configure, and integrate cloud solutions independently, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
* Manage deployments and upgrades for existing customers, focusing on “right first time” execution and quick issue resolution.
* Oversee New Product Introductions (NPI) for global rollouts, driving innovation and integrating cross-product solutions.
* Provide maintenance support and operations, including defect analysis, troubleshooting, and incident resolution.
* Create and update comprehensive project documentation, including MOPs, reports, and incident RCAs.
* Ensure robust configuration management by performing regular backups, optimizing backup routines, and maintaining accurate version control across hardware and software assets.

**Key Skills And Experience**
You have:
  
  

* Require any bachelor’s degree with related field.
* Typically, a minimum 5 to 10 years of telecom experience, with 5+ years in Cloud & OSS solutions.
* Proven expertise in OCP Platform Administration and Kubernetes management.
* Experience with CI/CD tools and automation technologies (e.g., Ansible, Helm).
* Good IP networking background and scripting capabilities (Shell, PERL, Python).
* Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration.
* L3 Certified Specialist on Open Shift & NCP, MantaRay.
* Skilled in Linux administration across multiple distributions (RHEL, CentOS, Rocky, Ubuntu) and proficient in private cloud platforms such as OpenStack, VMware, Kubernetes, Nokia CBIS/NCS, RH OpenShift, NCP, and VMware Tanzu.
* Proficient in scripting and automation using Linux shell, Python, and Perl for efficient operations and process optimization.

It would be nice if you also had:
  
  

* Strong background in Networking, VNF and CNF deployment readiness, onboarding support, and automation using tools like Terraform and Ansible. Familiarity with cloud security best practice and compliance.
* Experience with containerization tools like Docker and orchestration with ECS or EKS.
* Knowledge of monitoring and logging tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack).

title: Design & Planning Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
The Design & Planning Specialist designs, analyses, plans, and modifies network components supporting customer communication implementation activities. Develops and evaluates network performance criteria and measurement methods. Prepares the analysis of the short or long-term capacity needs for switching, routing transmission, and signalling. Conducts network architecture design, feasibility, and cost studies. Develops alternative routing scenarios and changes in required sequence of network activities. Conducts economic and population growth studies to determine impact on network capacity and development plan projections. Performs the end-to-end design activities (including surveys, design itself, and as-built) required for a physical network deployment.
  
  
**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**

* Lead the end-to-end integration of complex software solutions across Nokia Labs, Customer Labs, and Production environments.
* Contribute to Solution Description (SD), customer requirements, architecture documentation, and develop Low-Level Design (LLD) documents from architecture and HLDs.
* Design, develop, and execute Methods of Procedure (MOPs) to ensure consistent, "first-time-right" deployments, migrations, and software onboarding (CNFs) on Cloud Native platforms.
* Develop and execute Acceptance Test Plans (ATPs), support customer acceptance activities, and perform vertical and horizontal integration.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, support First Office Application (FOA) activities, provide timely resolutions, and ensure successful production deployments.
* Build trusted technical advisory relationships with customer engineering stakeholders while working autonomously and applying best practices to improve products, services, and delivery outcomes.
* Act as a technical leader, mentor, and advisor by guiding team members, contributing to task forces, and leading complex technical initiatives and migration activities.

**Key Skills And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master's preferred).
* 4+ years of telecom experience with Core Network deployment, integration, and validation (mandatory).
* Strong knowledge of Cloud Native technologies, DevOps, CI/CD, and hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and Helm (mandatory).
* Experience with Linux, basic shell scripting, TCP/IP networking, TLS certificates, Kubernetes firewall configuration, and editing YAML/JSON configuration files.
* Good understanding of telecom protocols and interfaces, including IPv4/IPv6, HTTP/HTTPS, REST, SOAP, LDAP, SPML, Diameter, XML, and YAML/JSON.
* Strong troubleshooting skills, including Wireshark log analysis, IP connectivity debugging, and network issue resolution.
* Experience executing functional, regression, sanity, load, and performance testing, including simulator/emulator setup and environment configuration.
* Experience preparing, adapting, and executing Methods of Procedure (MOPs) across lab, pre-production, and customer production environments.
* Highly desirable experience with automation, Python, shell scripting, Apache JMeter, Ansible, Chef, Kibana, SoapUI, Harbor Registry, MULTUS, and DANM Networks.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in global, cross-functional teams.

title: Solution Owner IT Cloud Infrastructure
description:
**Job Description**
 Infrastructure Subject Matter Expert (SME) will support end\-to\-end infra services in the public cloud. s part of operations, you will collaborate with architects, security teams, and end users to enhance, deploy, and support the database environment.
   

  

 EICS Public Cloud and Database Services, part of Nokia Digital Office EICS, follows a lifecycle\-based operating model that ensures end\-to\-end accountability across cloud service delivery for internal Nokia customers. Strategic planning and governance set the direction, solutions architecture translates that vision into scalable and secure designs, DevOps automation accelerates consistent delivery, and operations management maintains service reliability — all connected through a continuous feedback loop that drives ongoing improvement and ensures services consistently meet the evolving needs of internal Nokia team
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Mange the resource running in Azure, GCP, AWS and OCI, provide expert L4 administration, configuration, and troubleshooting for Linux, UNIX, and Windows servers.
* Manage and optimize enterprise VMware vSphere environments, including ESXi, vCenter, and advanced features.
* Design, implement, and manage enterprise SAN, NAS, and Object Storage solutions, administer and optimize enterprise backup and recovery systems (e.g., Azure , GCBDR or any ).
* Develop, implement, and test disaster recovery strategies to meet RTO/RPO objectives, act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure issues, leading root cause analysis.
* Drive automation initiatives using scripting (Shell, Python, PowerShell) and configuration management tools, perform advanced system performance tuning, capacity planning, and resource optimization.
* Implement and enforce security policies, ensuring compliance across all managed systems, mentor junior team members and create comprehensive documentation for systems and procedures and cloud teams, ensuring strong stakeholder communication and alignment.
* Monitor system health, troubleshooting issues, and perform root cause analysis, collaborate with DevOps, and application teams to support database needs.
* Establish best practices for database reliability, scaling, and observability


**Key Skills And Experience**
* Graduate degree with 15\+ years' experience in UNIX, Solaris, Windows, Virtualization, Storage \& Backup platforms.
* OS Admin: Expert\-level administration, configuration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, patching, and automation for Linux, UNIX, and Windows Server environments, including Active Directory.
* Virtualization: Design, implement, and manage enterprise VMware vSphere (ESXi, vCenter, vSAN, NSX), ensuring VM lifecycle, performance, HA, and DR.
* Public Cloud: Manage resources across Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, with strong understanding of PaaS/IaaS, migration strategies, and hybrid cloud integration.
* Storage Management: Design, implement, and manage enterprise SAN/NAS/Object storage solutions (NetApp, EMC, HPE), monitoring performance and troubleshooting issues.
* Backup \& Recovery: Administer and optimize enterprise backup solutions (Azure, GCBDR, NetBackup, Rubrik), developing and testing DR strategies to meet RTO/RPO.
* Automation \& Scripting: Drive automation initiatives using Shell, Python, PowerShell, and configuration management tools like Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.
* Security \& Mentorship: Implement security policies, ensure compliance, provide L4 incident support, and mentor junior team members while maintaining documentation.

description:

title: Solution Services Domain Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking a talented and experienced Solution Services Domain Architect to join our team. This role is responsible for building and maintaining full\-stack service labs, which includes integrating various cloud platforms and applications. The architect will design and implement end\-to\-end test setups that mimic customer architectures, ensuring seamless vertical and horizontal integration. Additionally, they will lead the execution of functional, regression, upgrade, stability, performance, and interoperability tests, developing automated test scripts to streamline the testing process.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Design and maintain full\-stack service labs, integrating applications, networks, and cloud platforms.
* Ensure vertical and horizontal integration across diverse cloud platforms and applications.
* Lead the execution of end\-to\-end test setups, matching NAM customer architectures and gold standards.
* Deploy and maintain automation infrastructure, including pipelines, tools, and scripts.
* Build and manage shared cloud lab environments, providing on\-demand access to domains.
* Keep labs stable, secure, and user\-friendly, ensuring optimal performance and security.
* Automate lab creation, teardown, and maintenance processes, reducing manual effort.
* Utilize scripts, pipelines, and APIs to minimize manual work and enhance efficiency.
* Lead the development of test scripts for automated testing, improving test coverage and speed.
* Track test progress, resolve issues, and validate results against requirements, delivering comprehensive validation reports.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must have:
   

  

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in software development, cloud computing, or a similar field.
* Knowledge of K8s and openstack cloud platforms, networking, and Nokia Core and BA application integration.
* Experience with Nokia automation tools, pipelines, and scripting languages.

title: MS Specialist Core
description:
**Job Description**
 Nokia Global Delivery operations comprise the NOC Operations (FCAPS) for the global telecom companies from all market segments. CSPs and Enterprise customers are served from the Nokia GDC. This Role will be responsible for end\-to\-end handling of network operations. Providing technical consultation and resolving queries/service tickets/incidents.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Providing technical support for complex Core nodes (Analysis, Troubleshooting \& fixing the issues reported) on already deployed to end customer/user.
* Technical Operations support for Customer Team.
* Manages technical escalations for technical requests, emergency cases and outages internally and towards customer.
* Support customer’s network performance and evolution.
* Manages network SW and HW configuration information.
* Acts as the prime technical interface towards customer, subcontractors and 3rd party suppliers as well as internally towards several organizations.
* Liaise closely with Multiple teams to work on the operation faults and technical management to ensure the Network stability.
* Monitors and reports customer’s life network performance and acts to ensure network’s availability including e.g. customer SLA fulfilment
* Support and perform competence development of local technical teams.
* Ensure multiple network Element are connected and all functions are working well.
* Handling Critical and Emergency network incidents with stakeholders/Care.


**Key Skills And Experience**
**Must\-Have:**
* Typically, a minimum experience on Platforms between 7\-10 yrs require
* Require Educational Qualification B.E/B.Tech.
* In\-depth understanding of OpenStack Architecture NFV, Mano \& its components like (component like Nova, Cinder, Neutron, Horizon, Glance, Keystone)
* Live experience in deploying / managing the Cloud Infra using OpenStack.
* System Administration of Linux ubuntu/OpenStack environment
* Storage knowledge like HP, EMC and IBM LUN creation and allocation
* Service deployment using the Virtualization, Orchestration, Image

* Linux distributions: Ubuntu, Centos, Red hat New installation and trouble shoot.

title: Customer Solutions Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 The Domain Architect is responsible for defining and implementing the Core domain\-wide strategy for Application(Cloud network function) deployment automation and AI\-enabled Automation SW development and delivery across various Nokia blueprint as well as customized product teams. The role requires deep expertise in cloud\-native technologies, Network function deployment automation frameworks, CI/CD ecosystems, and the application of AI capabilities to optimize development workstreams, operational efficiency and delivery velocity. The architect will drive scalable, maintainable automation solutions, enable self\-healing delivery pipelines, and mentor teams in modern DevOps and AI\-assisted SW engineering practices.
   

  

**How You Will Contribute And What You Will Learn**
* Lead requirement analysis, solution alignment, and end\-to\-end architecture activities, including HLD, LLD, CIQ validation and solution governance.
* Define migration strategies, provide technical leadership, and guide implementation activities across the complete migration lifecycle.
* Drive customization discussions, RCA execution, escalation management, and resolution of technical issues in collaboration with Care, R\&D and cross\-functional teams.
* Lead architecture workshops, design reviews, technical documentation, knowledge transfer, and delivery readiness activities to ensure successful solution deployment and adoption.
* Promote innovation through automation, AI\-driven solutions, next\-generation delivery practices, and close collaboration with R\&D/Development team on product enhancements.


**Key Skills And Experience**
 Must Have
   

  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science or a related field, with 10\+ years of experience in architecting software, IT, or telecom solutions.
* Exhibit extensive hands\-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, containerized application deployments.
* Proven experience in defining Cloud\-native architectures and delivering those solutions to the market.
* Experience working effectively in global organizations, with strong communication, motivational and technical leadership skills.
* Prior design and application deployment experience in custom solution and applications products.


 Nice\-to\-Have:
   

  

* Telecom domain exposure (Packet Core, 4G/5G, network protocols, cloud\-native network functions) and Experience in implementing autonomous deployment platforms or AI\-driven operational automation.
